senses.gloss: m. (imper. of a verb גחם to burn, Arab. ġaḥama, adopted for homiletical play on גחם, Gen. XXII, 24) burn them.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 102:5">Yalk. Gen. 102</cite>, end (from <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 57">Gen. R. s. 57</cite>, end) <he>גחם גחמון</he> Yalk. a. l. [Midr. ed. <cite ref="C01018"><he>גמחון</he></cite>.—The entire passage seems to be a late gloss.]
